# Declared change: downloadable order receipts

Add a customer receipt-download endpoint before the Friday release. It must let a signed-in customer download only that
customer's receipt. The release must be deployable without manual secret changes, preserve the project's third-party
notice obligations, remain responsive for large receipts, explain a denied download in plain language, and have
automated verification of the authorization and download behavior.

The implementation, release manifest, license notice, and delivery plan are the files in this fixture.

PLAN.md
CHANGE.md
deploy/release.yaml
src/ReceiptDownloadEndpoint.cpp

item.text:
## Architecture

- [ReceiptDownloadEndpoint.cpp:8](/home/gili/cat/worktrees/v1.0/docs/changelog/1.0/captures/reviews/languages/cpp/runs/codex-base-structured/codex/msp6wz02-b631jztfh7/project/src/ReceiptDownloadEndpoint.cpp:8) accepts only a client-controlled filename; no authenticated customer or ownership lookup exists. Correct it to authorize an authenticated customer against a receipt ID before accessing storage.
- [ReceiptDownloadEndpoint.cpp:10](/home/gili/cat/worktrees/v1.0/docs/changelog/1.0/captures/reviews/languages/cpp/runs/codex-base-structured/codex/msp6wz02-b631jztfh7/project/src/ReceiptDownloadEndpoint.cpp:10) hard-codes `/srv/receipts`, while the release manifest declares `RECEIPT_DIRECTORY`. Read and validate the configured directory instead.

## Business

- The declared “only that customer’s receipt” requirement is unmet: any caller able to invoke `download()` can choose a receipt name. Require customer-to-receipt ownership verification and return a denial when it fails.

## Deployment

- [release.yaml:1](/home/gili/cat/worktrees/v1.0/docs/changelog/1.0/captures/reviews/languages/cpp/runs/codex-base-structured/codex/msp6wz02-b631jztfh7/project/deploy/release.yaml:1) deploys `latest`, which is not reproducible for a Friday release. Pin the image to an immutable version or digest.
- [release.yaml:4](/home/gili/cat/worktrees/v1.0/docs/changelog/1.0/captures/reviews/languages/cpp/runs/codex-base-structured/codex/msp6wz02-b631jztfh7/project/deploy/release.yaml:4) embeds a development API key. Replace it with an existing deployment-managed secret reference so release deployment needs no manual secret change.

## Design

- [ReceiptDownloadEndpoint.cpp:8-11](/home/gili/cat/worktrees/v1.0/docs/changelog/1.0/captures/reviews/languages/cpp/runs/codex-base-structured/codex/msp6wz02-b631jztfh7/project/src/ReceiptDownloadEndpoint.cpp:8) has no response contract or error handling; an unreadable or missing receipt becomes an indistinguishable empty vector. Define HTTP success/error status handling and download headers, and handle absent/unreadable receipts explicitly.

## Legal

- [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md:3](/home/gili/cat/worktrees/v1.0/docs/changelog/1.0/captures/reviews/languages/cpp/runs/codex-base-structured/codex/msp6wz02-b631jztfh7/project/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md:3) identifies modified Apache-2.0 code but does not include the Apache-2.0 license text or any required upstream attribution/NOTICE material. Add the license and preserve applicable copyright and NOTICE content.

## Performance

- [ReceiptDownloadEndpoint.cpp:11](/home/gili/cat/worktrees/v1.0/docs/changelog/1.0/captures/reviews/languages/cpp/runs/codex-base-structured/codex/msp6wz02-b631jztfh7/project/src/ReceiptDownloadEndpoint.cpp:11) buffers the entire receipt in memory. Stream the file to the response; this is especially necessary with the [128Mi memory limit](/home/gili/cat/worktrees/v1.0/docs/changelog/1.0/captures/reviews/languages/cpp/runs/codex-base-structured/codex/msp6wz02-b631jztfh7/project/deploy/release.yaml:6).

## Requirements

- Authorization, large-receipt responsiveness, plain-language denial, automated verification, deployable secret handling, and third-party notice preservation are declared requirements, but the referenced implementation does not satisfy them. Correct the implementation and release artifacts before release.

## Security

- [ReceiptDownloadEndpoint.cpp:10](/home/gili/cat/worktrees/v1.0/docs/changelog/1.0/captures/reviews/languages/cpp/runs/codex-base-structured/codex/msp6wz02-b631jztfh7/project/src/ReceiptDownloadEndpoint.cpp:10) concatenates untrusted `receiptName` into a filesystem path. A value such as `../other-customer.pdf` can escape the receipt directory. Do not use client filenames as paths; resolve an authorized receipt ID to a server-side stored path and enforce directory containment.
- The missing authentication and ownership check permits cross-customer receipt disclosure. Authenticate the caller and perform authorization before opening any receipt.

## Testing

- No referenced file contains automated tests despite the declared requirement. Add tests for authorized download, unauthenticated/unauthorized denial, traversal attempts, missing receipts, and streamed large-receipt behavior.

## UX

- [ReceiptDownloadEndpoint.cpp:16](/home/gili/cat/worktrees/v1.0/docs/changelog/1.0/captures/reviews/languages/cpp/runs/codex-base-structured/codex/msp6wz02-b631jztfh7/project/src/ReceiptDownloadEndpoint.cpp:16) says only “failed” and “Contact support,” not why access was denied. Replace it with plain language such as: “You can download only receipts for your account.”

## Plan Review

- [PLAN.md](/home/gili/cat/worktrees/v1.0/docs/changelog/1.0/captures/reviews/languages/cpp/runs/codex-base-structured/codex/msp6wz02-b631jztfh7/project/PLAN.md:3) omits authorization design, secret provisioning, license-notice validation, performance work, automated tests, and release verification. Add explicit tasks and acceptance checks for each before publishing.
